subject: website
name: JSONAPI.ETH
summary: The page of JSONAPI.ETH, an ENS resolver that answers onchain queries as JSON. Its source is public (no licence file) and it runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: a query runs through an RPC endpoint and the resolver's off-chain gateway, run by its authors, whose answers the page does not check.

connections.name: RPC endpoint and the resolver's gateway
connections.note: Used when a query is submitted.
